hooks.command:
input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null) || cmd=$input; printf '%s
' "$cmd" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|({`])[[:space:]]*gh[[:space:]]+pr[[:space:]]+(create|new)([[:space:];&|)<>`]|$)' || exit 0; dir=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null); first=$(printf '%s
' "$cmd" | sed -n '/[^[:space:]]/{p;q;}'); dq=$(printf '%s
' "$first" | sed -nE 's/^[[:space:]]*cd[[:space:]]+"([^"]+)"[[:space:]]*&&.*/\1/p'); sq=$(printf '%s
' "$first" | sed -nE 's/^[[:space:]]*cd[[:space:]]+'''([^''']+)'''[[:space:]]*&&.*/\1/p'); bare=$(printf '%s
' "$first" | sed -nE 's/^[[:space:]]*cd[[:space:]]+([^[:space:];&|"''']+)[[:space:]]*&&.*/\1/p'); if [ -n "$sq" ]; then lead=$sq; else lead=${dq:-$bare}; if [ -n "$bare" ] && [ -z "$dq" ]; then case $lead in "~") lead=$HOME;; "~/"*) lead=$HOME/${lead#"~/"};; esac; fi; case $lead in '$HOME'|'${HOME}') lead=$HOME;; '$HOME/'*) lead=$HOME/${lead#'$HOME/'};; '${HOME}/'*) lead=$HOME/${lead#'${HOME}/'};; esac; fi; if [ -n "$lead" ]; then case $lead in /*) dir=$lead;; *) dir=${dir:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/$lead;; esac; fi; cd "${dir:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" || exit 2; if git notes --ref=review show HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; echo "HEAD ($(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)) of $(pwd) has no review note, so the pull request is refused. Review the change first with the ehos-dev:pre-pr-review skill (this repository's part is .claude/review.md), then mark this exact commit: git notes --ref=review add -m '<what the review found and what happened to it>' HEAD. A new commit, an amend or a rebase moves HEAD, and the new HEAD needs its own note." >&2; exit 2
hooks.statusMessage: Checking that this change was reviewed
